prompt: I want to know what common markdownlint rules I should be aware of. Can you give me a comprehensive list of important rules?

assertions.text: At least 15 distinct markdownlint rules are mentioned
MD047 (file should end with newline) is mentioned
MD034 is described correctly as flagging bare URLs (not as URLs in angle brackets)
Rules covering headings, lists, whitespace, and code blocks are all included
